title: Jeremiah's Complaint / The Lord's Answer

questions.question: Jeremiah asks the Lord: "Why does the way of the wicked... ? Why do all who are treacherous thrive?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:1 (ESV): "Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all who are treacherous thrive?"

questions.question: "You plant them, and they take root; they grow and produce fruit; you are near in their..., and far from their heart."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:2 (ESV): "you are near in their mouth and far from their heart."

questions.question: "But you, O Lord, know me; you see me, and test my... toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and set them apart for the day of slaughter."
The Lord answers Jeremiah: "If you have raced with men on foot, and they have wearied you, how will you compete with... ?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:5 (ESV): "If you have raced with men on foot, and they have wearied you, how will you compete with horses?"

questions.question: "And if in a safe land you are so trusting, what will you do in the thicket of the... ?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:5 (ESV): "what will you do in the thicket of the Jordan?"

questions.question: "For even your brothers and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; they are in full... after you;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:6 (ESV): "they are in full cry after you; do not believe them, though they speak friendly words to you."

questions.question: "I have forsaken my..., I have abandoned my heritage; I have given the beloved of my soul into the hands of her enemies."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:7 (ESV): "I have forsaken my house, I have abandoned my heritage;"

questions.question: "My heritage has become to me like a... in the forest; she has lifted up her voice against me; therefore I hate her."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:8 (ESV): "My heritage has become to me like a lion in the forest;"

questions.question: "Many... have destroyed my vineyard; they have trampled down my portion; they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:10 (ESV): "Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard;"

questions.question: "They have sown... and have reaped thorns; they have tired themselves out but profit nothing."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:13 (ESV): "They have sown wheat and have reaped thorns;"

questions.question: Thus says the Lord concerning all his evil neighbors who touch the heritage of Israel: "Behold, I will... them from their land,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:14 (ESV): "Behold, I will pluck them up from their land,"

questions.question: "...and I will pluck up the house of... from among them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:14 (ESV): "and I will pluck up the house of Judah from among them."

questions.question: "And after I have plucked them up, I will again have... on them, and I will bring them again each to his heritage and each to his land."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:15 (ESV): "And after I have plucked them up, I will again have compassion on them,"

questions.question: "And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, 'As the Lord lives,'... then they shall be... in the midst of my people."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:16 (ESV): "then they shall be built up in the midst of my people."

questions.question: "But if any nation will not..., then I will utterly pluck it up and destroy it, declares the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 12:17 (ESV): "But if any nation will not listen, then I will utterly pluck it up and destroy it, declares the Lord."

key_verse_text: Righteous are you, O Lord, when I complain to you; yet I would plead my case before you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all who are treacherous thrive? You plant them, and they take root; they grow and produce fruit; you are near in their mouth and far from their heart.
